Starting by inspecting the project layout and the build contract.

I'll write the files one at a time.

The shell calls keep truncating, so I'll use smaller edits.

The edit did apply. Now the full check, then a clean `-j8` build, an incremental no-op build, and the debug build.

The build now meets the contract in `docs/BUILDING.md`. Everything I checked passed: 22 unit tests and all 34 golden cases, in both the release and `DEBUG=1` configurations. I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status "success".

**What I changed**
- **Stray header:** I deleted `include/qs/ops.h`. It was an out-of-date copy of the generated header, with the wrong `neg` precedence, wrong `pow` associativity and two operations missing. `ops.h` and `version.h` now come only from `build/gen/qs/`, produced by the `build-aux` scripts.
- **Makefiles:**
  - Dependency tracking is added, so header, `VERSION` and `src/ops.def` changes trigger rebuilds, and a second `make` does nothing.
  - Source discovery picks up any new `.c` file in `lib/` or the tool directories.
  - The programs link statically, with the library and `-lm` after the objects.
  - `DEBUG=1` now uses `-O1 -g -DQS_TRACE`, and switching between release and debug rebuilds everything.
  - `CC` can be overridden.
  - `check` runs both suites and exits non-zero if either fails.
  - `install` installs exactly the files the doc lists, and records the `PREFIX` given to `make install` in `qs.pc`.
- **Warnings fixed in code:** missing `<stdlib.h>`, unused parameters and variables, sign comparisons, fall-through in the size parser, `%d` used for `size_t`, and an assignment used as a condition. A `-Wswitch` warning in the parser is also fixed. The code used `QS_DEBUG`; it now uses `QS_TRACE`.
- **Real bugs fixed alongside:** the `-c` column lookup in `colstat` tested the wrong condition. A prefix `-` in `qcalc` now takes operators that bind strictly tighter than `neg`, as the doc says. `--max-size` rejects a value that overflows instead of silently wrapping.

**What I ran**
- Clean-tree builds at `-j8` of each target alone (`all`, the library, both programs, `check`, `install`), three times each, all succeeded.
- Touching a header, changing `VERSION`, and changing `src/ops.def` each rebuilt what depended on it. Changing the `neg` precedence in `src/ops.def` changed how `qcalc` groups `-2*3`.
- A deliberately wrong golden case made `make check` exit 2.
- A staged `make install` produced exactly the documented tree, with `PREFIX` recorded in `qs.pc`.

I did not compile a program against the installed headers and library. The one judgment call is that an overflowing `--max-size` is treated as an invalid size (a usage error) rather than clamped. The docs don't say which.

cd /app && rm include/qs/ops.h && cat > mk/gen.mk <<'EOF'
# Generated headers. They live in build/gen only.

GEN_OPS     := $(GENDIR)/qs/ops.h
GEN_VERSION := $(GENDIR)/qs/version.h
GEN_HDRS    := $(GEN_OPS) $(GEN_VERSION)

.PHONY: gen
gen: $(GEN_HDRS)

$(GEN_OPS): src/ops.def build-aux/genops.sh
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	sh build-aux/genops.sh src/ops.def > $@.tmp
	mv $@.tmp $@

$(GEN_VERSION): VERSION build-aux/mkversion.sh
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	sh build-aux/mkversion.sh VERSION > $@.tmp
	mv $@.tmp $@
EOF
cat > mk/lib.mk <<'EOF'
# libqs.a

LIB_SRCS := $(sort $(shell find lib -name '*.c'))
LIB_OBJS := $(LIB_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
LIBQS    := $(LIBDIR)/libqs.a

.PHONY: lib
lib: $(LIBQS)

$(LIBQS): $(LIB_OBJS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	rm -f $@
	$(AR) $(ARFLAGS) $@ $^

$(OBJDIR)/lib/%.o: lib/%.c $(FLAGS_STAMP) | $(GEN_HDRS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LIB_CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) -MMD -MP -c $< -o $@
EOF
cat > mk/tools.mk <<'EOF'
# colstat and qcalc

COLSTAT_SRCS := $(sort $(shell find tools/colstat -name '*.c'))
QCALC_SRCS   := $(sort $(shell find tools/qcalc -name '*.c'))
COLSTAT_OBJS := $(COLSTAT_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
QCALC_OBJS   := $(QCALC_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
BINS         := $(BINDIR)/colstat $(BINDIR)/qcalc

.PHONY: tools
tools: $(BINS)

$(BINDIR)/colstat: $(COLSTAT_OBJS) $(LIBQS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LDFLAGS) -static $(COLSTAT_OBJS) $(LIBQS) $(LDLIBS) -o $@

$(BINDIR)/qcalc: $(QCALC_OBJS) $(LIBQS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LDFLAGS) -static $(QCALC_OBJS) $(LIBQS) $(LDLIBS) -o $@

$(OBJDIR)/tools/%.o: tools/%.c $(FLAGS_STAMP) | $(GEN_HDRS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(TOOL_CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) -MMD -MP -c $< -o $@
EOF
cat > mk/check.mk <<'EOF'
# make check: unit tests and the golden cases against the built programs.

UNIT_SRCS   := $(sort $(wildcard tests/unit/*.c))
UNIT_OBJS   := $(UNIT_SRCS:%.c=$(OBJDIR)/%.o)
UNIT_RUNNER := $(BUILD)/tests/unit_runner

$(UNIT_RUNNER): $(UNIT_OBJS) $(LIBQS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LDFLAGS) $(UNIT_OBJS) $(LIBQS) $(LDLIBS) -o $@

$(OBJDIR)/tests/%.o: tests/%.c $(FLAGS_STAMP) | $(GEN_HDRS)
	@mkdir -p $(@D)
	$(CC) $(LIB_CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) -MMD -MP -c $< -o $@

.PHONY: check
check: $(UNIT_RUNNER) $(BINS)
	@mkdir -p $(BUILD)/tests
	@rc=0; \
	$(UNIT_RUNNER) > $(BUILD)/tests/unit.log 2>&1 || rc=1; cat $(BUILD)/tests/unit.log; \
	sh tests/golden.sh $(BINDIR) > $(BUILD)/tests/golden.log 2>&1 || rc=1; cat $(BUILD)/tests/golden.log; \
	exit $$rc
EOF
cat > mk/install.mk <<'EOF'
# make install [PREFIX=...] [DESTDIR=...]

PC_FILE := $(BUILD)/qs.pc

.PHONY: install
install: all
	$(INSTALL) -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig
	$(INSTALL) -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/include/qs $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/share/man/man1
	$(INSTALL) -m 755 $(BINS) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 $(LIBQS) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 include/qs/*.h $(GEN_VERSION) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/include/qs
	sed -e 's|@PREFIX@|$(PREFIX)|g' -e "s|@VERSION@|$$(sed -n '1{s/[[:space:]]//g;p;}' VERSION)|g" qs.pc.in > $(PC_FILE)
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 $(PC_FILE) $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/pkgconfig/qs.pc
	$(INSTALL) -m 644 man/*.1 $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/share/man/man1
EOF
cat > Makefile <<'EOF'

include mk/config.mk

include mk/install.mk

all: gen lib tools

.PHONY: clean
clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)

-include $(shell find $(OBJDIR) -name '*.d' 2>/dev/null)
EOF
